title: Hong Kong Syndicate Allegedly Used AI-Generated Facial Composites to Open Bank Accounts

behaviors.text: Hong Kong police reportedly arrested eight individuals accused of using purportedly AI-generated facial composites to open bank accounts with altered ID photos.
The accounts were then allegedly used to apply for loans and make credit card purchases totaling HK$860,000, and to launder over HK$1.2 million in suspected criminal proceeds.
